problem:
Find the missing values in the following truth table:

| $\,A\,$ | $\,B\,$ | $\,¬(¬A∨B)\,$ |
| --- | --- | --- |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ | {{field-1}} |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | {{field-2}} |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ | {{field-3}} |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | {{field-4}} |

feedback.problem:
Find the missing values in the following truth table:

| $\,P\,$ | $\,Q\,$ | $\,¬P∨¬Q\,$ |
| --- | --- | --- |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ | {{field-1}} |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | {{field-2}} |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ | {{field-3}} |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | {{field-4}} |
feedback.worked_solution:
First, we add the columns for $¬P$ and $¬Q,$ 
where the truth values are opposite to the corresponding values in the columns for $P$ and $Q,$ respectively.

| $\,P\,$ | $\,¬P\,$ | $\,Q\,$ | $\,¬Q\,$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ |

Then, we add a column for $¬P∨¬Q.$ Remember that $¬P∨¬Q$ is true if either $¬P$ is true or $¬Q$ is true.

| $\,P\,$ | $\,¬P\,$ | $\,Q\,$ | $\,¬Q\,$ | $\,¬P∨¬Q\,$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ |
